# Data Source: proxmox_cluster_firewall_security_groups

Retrieves all cluster-level firewall security groups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_cluster_firewall_security_groups" "all" {}

output "security_group_names" {
  value = data.proxmox_cluster_firewall_security_groups.all.groups[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) Security groups, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Security group comment. Empty when not set.
- `name` (String) Security group name.
